actions.openFeedTaxonomyRevisions.label: Taxonomy updates
actions.openFeedTaxonomyRevisions.descri: Check for newer Google and Meta category lists and decide whether to adopt them
revisions.title: Taxonomy updates
revisions.subtitle: Google and Meta reorganise their category lists once or twice a year. Nothing here changes your feeds until you choose it.
revisions.list.title: Category lists on this platform
revisions.available.title: A newer {provider} category list is waiting
revisions.available.body: Revision {revision}, downloaded {ago} · {count} categories. Your feeds have not changed, and will not change until you promote it.
revisions.upToDate.title: You are on the newest list {provider} publishes
revisions.badge.shrinkHelp: {provider} published a list with {removed} fewer categories. That is their decision to make — the preview shows what it would cost you.
revisions.loadFailed: The taxonomy updates could not be loaded. Nothing on this screen changes what your feeds send.
revisions.empty: No category list is installed for {provider} yet.
revisions.checks.title: Recent checks ({count})
revisions.off.title: This platform does not check for new category lists
revisions.off.body: Your feeds use the lists installed here, and nothing is fetched from Google or Meta. Many installations run this way on purpose.
revisions.off.urls.intro: If you turn checking on, once a week the platform will download these files and nothing else:
revisions.off.urls.promise: A downloaded list is never used until you promote it on this screen.
revisions.off.checkRefused: Automatic checks are off, so the platform will not contact {provider}. Turn on "Check for new taxonomy revisions" in Settings first.
checks.outcome.installed: A newer list was found and downloaded
checks.outcome.unchanged: No change — {provider} is serving the same list
checks.outcome.failed: The check could not be completed
checks.unaffected: Your feeds are unaffected and keep using revision {revision}.
checks.reason.transport: The platform could not reach {host}. That usually means this server has no outbound internet access, or a proxy or firewall is blocking it — not that {provider} changed anything.
checks.reason.transport.hint: If this platform reaches the internet through a proxy, point the source address in Settings at the proxy or at an internal copy of the file.
checks.reason.not_found: {provider} no longer publishes a file at {url} (HTTP {status}). The address has moved — find the current one in {provider}’s documentation and update it in Settings.
checks.reason.http_status: {provider} answered with HTTP {status}. Nothing was downloaded; this is usually temporary on their side. The next check is {next}.
checks.reason.not_taxonomy: {url} returned a web page, not a category list. That is usually a login screen, a proxy notice or an error page — open the address in a browser to see what it actually serves.
checks.reason.empty: {url} returned an empty file. Nothing was installed.
checks.reason.truncated: The download stopped before the file was complete ({read} of {expected}). Nothing was installed.
checks.reason.too_large: The file was larger than the {limit} this platform will download. Nothing was installed.
checks.reason.no_nodes: The file downloaded, but no categories could be read from it — its format has probably changed. Nothing was installed.
checks.reason.implausible: The file downloaded, but only {count} categories could be read — far too few for a {provider} list. Nothing was installed.
checks.reason.incomplete_languages: The {ok} file downloaded but the {failed} one did not. A list is installed only when both languages are complete, so nothing was installed.
impact.title: {provider} revision {revision}
impact.verdict.first: This is the first {provider} category list on this platform. Nothing you have set up can break.
impact.verdict.safe: Nothing you have mapped breaks. Every category keeps its {provider} category.
impact.verdict.stale: {stale} of your mappings point at categories {provider} removed — but every one of your categories still gets a {provider} category from a parent, so your feeds send the same number of categories as today.
impact.verdict.loss: {losing} of your {total} categories would stop sending a {provider} category.
impact.verdict.lossDescendants: {descendants} categories below them lose it too, through inheritance.
impact.coverage.heading: Categories covered
impact.coverage.afterAria: Categories covered after promoting this list
impact.mappings.heading: Your mappings ({total})
impact.nodes.heading: {provider}’s list
impact.wait: If you wait: your feeds keep using {revision}, and the {added} new {provider} categories cannot be mapped. Nothing expires — this list stays here until you decide.
impact.truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total}. After promoting, the full list is on Category mapping under "Needs review".
impact.reassurance: Nothing is deleted. Broken mappings move to "Needs review", and you can return to {revision} whenever you like.
impact.current: This is the list your feeds use now.
impact.loadFailed: The effect of this list could not be calculated, and nothing was changed. Try again — the calculation only reads your data.
promote.confirm.title: Use {provider}’s {revision} list from now on?
promote.confirm.body: From their next generation, your feeds send categories from this list. {stale} of your mappings will move to "Needs review" — nothing is deleted, and you can return to {previous} at any time.
promote.conflict.title: The numbers changed while this was open
promote.conflict.body: Someone edited your category mappings, so the figures you were shown are no longer right. They have been recalculated — have another look before you promote.
promote.alreadyCurrent: Someone promoted this list while you were reading. It is the one your feeds use now.
promote.failed: The list could not be promoted, and nothing was changed. {reason}
revisions.a11y.checkStarted: Checking {provider} for a newer category list.
revisions.a11y.installed: A newer {provider} list is available: revision {revision}.
impact.a11y.refreshed: The figures changed. {stale} mappings would now need a new category.
promote.a11y.done: Revision {revision} promoted. Opening the mappings that need review.
mapping.updates.badgeAria: {count} newer category lists are waiting to be reviewed
mapping.promoted.title: {provider} now uses revision {revision}
mapping.promoted.body: {count} mappings point at categories {provider} removed. Nothing was deleted — pick a new category for each, or leave them and those products will send no {provider} category.
mapping.promoted.clean: {provider} now uses revision {revision}. Nothing needed fixing.
